title: Chicken and Sweetcorn Pasta Salad
subtitle: Poached chicken and tinned sweetcorn in a light mayo-mustard dressing
excerpt: Short pasta with poached and shredded chicken breast, tinned sweetcorn and spring onion, dressed in a light mayo-mustard sauce. A practical lunch and reliable picnic staple.
sourceNotes: Chicken and sweetcorn pasta salad became a fixture of British workplace canteens and sandwich bar counters in the 1980s and 1990s, part of the same repertoire as coronation chicken and prawn Marie Rose. It draws on American-influenced pasta salad culture and uses the mild, sweet combination of poached chicken and tinned corn that became reliable crowd-pleasing shorthand during this period.

recipe.batchNotes: Doubles easily. Keeps in the fridge for up to 2 days.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble a day ahead. Stir before serving and add extra dressing if the pasta has absorbed it.

content.text: Chicken and sweetcorn pasta salad is mild, filling, and easy to make ahead. The key is poaching the chicken gently in seasoned water rather than boiling it, which keeps it moist enough to shred into tender pieces rather than dry strings. Use a light dressing: enough mayo to coat, thinned with a little mustard and lemon, so the salad does not become heavy.

Place {{chicken-breast}} chicken breasts in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Season generously with salt. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 to 17 minutes, until the thickest part shows no pink when cut. Remove from the water and cool for 5 minutes, then shred with two forks into rough pieces.
Cook {{pasta-dried}} of pasta in well-salted boiling water until just tender. Drain and rinse briefly under cold water to stop it cooking, then drain again.

Stir together {{mayonnaise}} of mayonnaise, {{dijon-mustard}} of Dijon mustard, lemon juice, {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt and {{black-pepper}} of pepper. Combine the pasta, shredded chicken, {{sweetcorn-tinned}} of drained sweetcorn and spring onion in a large bowl. Pour the dressing over and toss until everything is coated. Chill for 15 minutes before serving. Scatter over parsley if using.

items.cause: Overcooked, or boiled at too high a heat.
items.fix: Poach at a gentle simmer. Pull the chicken out as soon as it is just cooked through; overcooking by even 5 minutes makes a noticeable difference to the texture.

items.cause: Pasta absorbed the dressing while cold.
items.fix: Reserve 1 tablespoon of dressing to stir through just before serving. Cold pasta thickens sauces quickly.

content.text: Chicken and sweetcorn pasta salad is a British invention of the 1980s, shaped by canteen culture and the era of the prawn sandwich. It is practical rather than elegant: mild, child-friendly, and it keeps in the fridge for two days. That makes it more useful than it looks.
